text:
Asha (CSM): Alert from monitoring  VelvetAI generation DAU down ~55% last 5 days, active seats 36 -> 14. Renewal in ~3.5 weeks. Posting here to triage. Dash: https://redwood.app/metrics/velvet

Vik (CS Ops): I see the drop. Generation calls down, embeddings steady. No 5xxs, but error rate for truncated responses up. p95 latency climbed from ~700ms to ~1.6s over the last 72h.

Cam (AE): Any sign of champion change or procurement pressure? Could be them shopping.

Asha (CSM): Champion Lior moved to infra last month; new contact is Data Lead Pri. Pri replied to a billing note saying theyre trying a cost cap and limited max_tokens. Procurement asked for a usage memo.

Rafael (Product): We pushed a token-budget variant two weeks ago on low-cost routing. If they were auto-routed, output truncation would match their symptom. I'll check routing map for account velvet.int and timestamp 1809900000+.

Nora (Support): Ticket V-2109 opened, asked for sample prompts. Pri shared one: {"model":"rw-gen-2","prompt":"Write a patient summary...","max_tokens":120}. She said reply cuts mid-paragraph.

Cam (AE): If champion faded and they're experimenting with competitors, we should offer a stabilization window. Suggest a 30-day Dedicated trial with throughput credits and an exec sync. Legal ok to fast-track SOW for trials?

Vik (CS Ops): SDK in use is v1.9 for Velvets integration. v1.9 doesn't change batch behavior but their infra set concurrency cap to 6 on 1809954000 per their note. That combo could drop parallel requests and reduce observed DAU.

Asha (CSM): Immediate plan proposal: 1) Cam: try exec intro + pilot offer today; 2) Rafael: confirm routing and run a revert test (10% traffic to prior variant) if customer ok; 3) Vik/Nora: validate concurrency vs SDK retry patterns and reproduce truncation in our sandbox with provided payloads; 4) Asha: draft customer-facing note including stabilization offer and a simple ROI summary for procurement.

Rafael (Product): I can confirm routing by EOD. If they permit, I'll run an A/B revert for a short window to gather metrics.

Nora (Support): Repro attempt scheduled now. If truncation reproduces, we'll collect raw request/response traces and add them to V-2109.

Cam (AE): I'll ask for a 30-min exec call and propose the trial. Also looping finance for a one-off credit. ETA intro EOD.

Vik (CS Ops): Action items assigned: Rafael routing (owner) ETA tomorrow 11am PT; Cam exec+offer ETA EOD; Nora collect traces ETA 3pm; Asha assemble procurement note ETA tomorrow noon. If we confirm variant routing + customer consents, recommend temporary Dedicated window as mitigation ahead of renewal.

AlertBot: Scheduled: VelvetAI routing + truncation healthcheck  results to V-2109. ETA 25m.

Asha (CSM): Thanks all. Let's avoid overlaps on outreach. I'll post the draft customer note here once ready. :ok_hand:
